en: Colossians 1

p.src: 1  Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

ja: のみこころによってキリスト・イエスの
en: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
u.src: 1  Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

ja: 1:1 「キリスト」は「油を注がれた者」という意味である。
en: 1:1 “Christ” means “Anointed One”.

p.src: 2  to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

ja: イエス・キリストから、
和があなたがたにありますように。
en: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
u.src: 2  to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

ja: 1:2 ここで「兄弟たち」と訳された語は、文脈によっては「兄弟姉妹」または「きょうだいたち」と訳すこともできる。
en: 1:2 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.”

p.src: 3  We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

ja: 私たちは、いつもあなたがたのために
en: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
u.src: 3  We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

p.src: 4  having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,

ja: キリスト・イエスに対するあなたがたの
en: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,
u.src: 4  having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,

p.src: 5  because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News

ja: その信仰と愛は、あなたがたのために
によるものです。あなたがたは
である福音によって、この希望について
en: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News
u.src: 5  because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News

p.src: 6  which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,

ja: はあなたがたのもとまで
しています。あなたがたが
じように実を結び、成長しています。
en: which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,
u.src: 6  which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,

p.src: 7  even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on your behalf,

ja: あなたがたはこの恵みを、私たちと共に仕える
するしもべエパフラスから
はあなたがたのために
en: even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on your behalf,
u.src: 7  even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on your behalf,

en: 1:7 NU reads our

p.src: 8  who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.

en: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.
u.src: 8  who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.

p.src: 9  For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

ja: から、あなたがたのために
り求めることをやめません。どうかあなたがたが、あらゆる
のみこころについての
識に満たされますように。
en: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,
u.src: 9  For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

p.src: 10  that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,

ja: そして、あらゆる点で主を喜ばせるよう、
る知識において成長しますように。
en: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,
u.src: 10  that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,

p.src: 11  strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,

ja: びをもって、どんなことにも耐え忍ぶことができますように。
en: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,
u.src: 11  strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,

p.src: 12  giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,

ja: にあずかるにふさわしい者としてくださった
をささげることができますように。
en: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,
u.src: 12  giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,

p.src: 13  who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,

en: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,
u.src: 13  who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,

p.src: 14  in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.

en: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.
u.src: 14  in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.

ja: 1:14 TRは「その血によって」を加えている。
en: 1:14 TR adds “through his blood,”

p.src: 15  He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.

ja: のかたちであり、すべての被
en: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.
u.src: 15  He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.

p.src: 16  For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.

en: For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.
u.src: 16  For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.

p.src: 17  He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.

ja: 御子はすべてのものより
en: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.
u.src: 17  He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.

p.src: 18  He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.

ja: 御子はその体、すなわち
からの長子です。それは、御子があらゆることにおいて
en: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.
u.src: 18  He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.

p.src: 19  For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,

ja: ちた豊かさのすべてが御子のうちに
ることが、みこころにかなったからです。
en: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,
u.src: 19  For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,

p.src: 20  and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.

ja: にあるものも、万物を御子によってご
させることを喜ばれました。
en: and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.
u.src: 20  and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.

p.src: 21  You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,

ja: いによって神から離れ、
en: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,
u.src: 21  You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,

p.src: 22  yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,

ja: なれたことにより、あなたがたをご
させてくださいました。それは、あなたがたを
められるところのない
en: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,
u.src: 22  yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,

p.src: 23  if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

ja: もっとも、あなたがたが
かされずにいるならばです。この
パウロはそのしもべとなりました。
en: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.
u.src: 23  if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

zh:
1:23 原文是離開
1:23 原文是凡受造的

p.src: 24  Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,

ja: はあなたがたのために受ける
んでいます。そしてキリストの体、すなわち
に欠けているものを、自分の
体において補っています。
en: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,
u.src: 24  Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,

p.src: 25  of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,

ja: は、あなたがたのために
から委ねられた管理の
い、神の言葉を余すところなく伝えるために、
のしもべとなりました。
en: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,
u.src: 25  of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,

p.src: 26  the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,

ja: です。しかし今、この奥義は
en: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,
u.src: 26  the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,

p.src: 27  to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

ja: らせることを喜ばれました。この奥義とは、あなたがたのうちにおられるキリスト、すなわち
en: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
u.src: 27  to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

p.src: 28  We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;

ja: たちはこのキリストを
えています。それは、すべての
をキリスト・イエスにあって完全な
en: We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;
u.src: 28  We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;

p.src: 29  for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.

en: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.
